79673.commentary: (VINa) kas'āhato katadaṇḍakammo'ti ettha yo vacanapesan'ādīni akaronto haññati, na so katadaṇḍakammo. yo pana keṇiyā vā aññathā vā kiñci gahetvā khāditvā puna dātuṃ asakkonto ayam'eva te daṇḍo hotū'ti kasāhi haññati, ayaṃ kas'āhato katadaṇḍakammo.

examples.text: bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. na, bhikkhave, kas'āhato katadaṇḍakammo pabbājetabbo. yo pabbājeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassā'ti.
lakkhaṇ'āhatavatthu niṭṭhitaṃ.

79675.commentary: (VINa) lakkhaṇ'āhato katadaṇḍakammo'ti… yassa pana nalāṭe vā ūruādīsu vā tattena lohena lakkhaṇaṃ āhataṃ hoti, so sace bhujisso yāva allavaṇo hoti, tāva na pabbājetabbo. sace'pi'ssa vaṇā ruḷhā honti, chaviyā samaparicchedā, lakkhaṇaṃ na paññāyati, timaṇḍalavatthassa uttarāsaṅge kate paṭicchann'okāse ce hoti, pabbājetuṃ vaṭṭati, appaṭicchann'okāse ce na vaṭṭati.

examples.text: bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. na, bhikkhave, lakkhaṇ'āhato katadaṇḍakammo pabbājetabbo. yo pabbājeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassā'ti.
iṇāyikavatthu niṭṭhitaṃ.
dāsavatthu niṭṭhitaṃ.

79678.meaning1: case of the shaven-headed blacksmith; story about one who carries blacksmith tools
79678.commentary: (VINa) kammārabhaṇḍū'ti tulādhāramuṇḍako suvaṇṇakāraputto, pañcasikho taruṇadārako'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: kammārabhaṇḍuvatthu niṭṭhitaṃ.

79679.meaning1: to obtain permission (for); to give notice (about)
79679.commentary: (VINa) saṅghaṃ apaloketuṃ bhaṇḍukammāyā'ti saṅghaṃ bhaṇḍukamm'atthāya āpucchituṃ anujānāmī'ti attho. (PYt) apaloketun'ti ettha apapubbo lokasaddo āpucchan'attho'ti āha āpucchitun'ti.

examples.text: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. anujānāmi, bhikkhave, saṅghaṃ apaloketuṃ bhaṇḍukammāyā'ti.
upālidārakavatthu niṭṭhitaṃ.

79681.meaning1: case of the plague; story about cholera

examples.text: ahivātakarogavatthu niṭṭhitaṃ.
tena kho pana samayena aññataraṃ kulaṃ ahivātakarogena kālaṅ'kataṃ hoti. tassa pitāputtakā sesā honti. te bhikkhūsu pabbajitvā ekato'va piṇḍāya caranti.
atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. na, bhikkhave, ūnapannarasavasso dārako pabbājetabbo. yo pabbājeyya, āpatti dukkaṭassā'ti.

79684.grammar: prp of caus pass of apa √sad, caus, pass, intrans (+instr)

examples.text: bhikkhū apasādenti. te bhikkhūhi apasādiyamānā rodanti. atha kho āyasmato ānandassa etadahosi, bhagavatā paññattaṃ na ūnapannarasavasso dārako pabbājetabbo'ti.

79685.meaning1: (of a bird) to scare away; to chase off

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesi. ussahanti pana te, ānanda, dārakā kāke uḍḍāpetun'ti? ussahanti, bhagavā'ti.
kaṇṭakavatthu niṭṭhitaṃ.

79687.meaning1: case of crowding; story about being blocked up

examples.text: āhundarikavatthu niṭṭhitaṃ.

atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ. atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, gacch'ānanda, avāpuraṇaṃ ādāya anupariveṇiyaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ārocehi, icchat'āvuso bhagavā dakkhiṇāgiriṃ cārikaṃ pakkamituṃ.

79689.meaning1: should be returned; should come back

examples.text: tattha ca no gantabbaṃ bhavissati, nissayo ca gahetabbo bhavissati, ittaro ca vāso bhavissati, puna ca paccāgantabbaṃ bhavissati, puna ca nissayo gahetabbo bhavissati.

79690.meaning1: indeed for him; certainly to that; truly to him

examples.text: sampajānamusāvādo kho pan'āyasmanto antarāyiko dhammo vutto bhagavatā, tasmā saramānena bhikkhunā āpannena visuddh'āpekkhena santī āpatti āvikātabbā, āvikatā hi'ssa phāsu hoti.

79691.construction:
lahu + citta + ka + tā
lahucittaka + tā

examples.text: sace amhākaṃ ācariy'upajjhāyā gamissan'ti, mayam'pi gamissāma, no ce amhākaṃ ācariy'upajjhāyā gamissanti, mayam'pi na gamissāma. lahucittakatā no, āvuso ānanda, paññāyissatī'ti.

79692.commentary: (VINa) nissayamuccanakena upasampadāya pañcavassena sabb'antimena paricchedena dve mātikā paguṇā vāc'uggatā kātabbā pakkhadivasesu dhammasāvan'atthāya sutt'antato cattāro bhāṇavārā, sampattānaṃ parikathan'atthāya andhakavinda-mahārāhul'ovāda-ambaṭṭha-sadiso eko kathāmaggo, saṅghabhattamaṅgal'āmaṅgalesu anumodan'atthāya tisso anumodanā, uposatha-pavāraṇ'ādi-jānan'atthaṃ kamm'ākammavinicchayo, samaṇadhammakaraṇ'atthaṃ samādhivasena vā vipassanāvasena vā arahattapariyosānam'ekaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ, ettakaṃ uggahetabbaṃ. ettāvatā hi ayaṃ bahussuto hoti cātuddiso, yattha katthaci attano issariyena vasituṃ labhati. (PYt) nissayato muccatī'ti nissayamuccanako.

examples.text: nissayamuccanakakathā niṭṭhitā.

79693.meaning1: discussion about release from formal dependence

examples.text: nissayamuccanakakathā niṭṭhitā.

79694.meaning1: having less than five years as a monk; fewer than five rains

examples.text: āpattiṃ na jānāti, anāpattiṃ na jānāti, lahukaṃ āpattiṃ na jānāti, garukaṃ āpattiṃ na jānāti, ūnapañcavasso hoti, imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcah'aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na anissitena vatthabbaṃ.

79695.meaning1: having five years of seniority; with five rains

examples.text: saddho hoti, hirimā hoti, ottappī hoti, āraddhavīriyo hoti, upaṭṭhitassati hoti, pañcavasso vā hoti atirekapañcavasso vā, imehi kho, bhikkhave, chahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ.

79696.meaning1: having five or more years of seniority; of five rains or more

examples.text: asekkhena vimuttikkhandhena, asekkhena vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena samannāgato hoti, pañcavasso vā hoti atirekapañcavasso vā, imehi kho, bhikkhave, chahaṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā anissitena vatthabbaṃ.
abhay'ūvarabhāṇavāro niṭṭhito aṭṭhamo.
rāhulavatthu niṭṭhitaṃ.
